annotations.title: Search characters by Vietnamese reading or meaning

description:
Find Hán Nôm characters by their Vietnamese reading (quốc ngữ, e.g. "trăng") or by Vietnamese meaning. Use when you need to discover which characters correspond to a Vietnamese word, then call lookup_character on the result for full detail.

Each result reports what actually matched — "matchedOn" is "reading" or "meaning", and "match" carries the exact reading or the definition containing your query, with its source. Do not treat that definition as the character's only sense; call lookup_character for the rest.

Returns at most 20 characters per call, with no pagination. This dictionary's readings and meanings come from sources under CC BY-SA 4.0, so bulk redistribution carries ShareAlike obligations — the cap keeps ordinary use well inside that. Cite the source on each result rather than presenting the corpus as your own.

query.description: A Vietnamese reading in quốc ngữ (e.g. "trăng") or a Vietnamese meaning fragment.

name: search_corpus

definition.description: Set when matchedOn is "meaning": the definition containing the query.

entryId.description: Entry id within that work, e.g. "B-0123".

reading.description: Set when matchedOn is "reading": the exact reading that matched.

readings.description: ALL readings of this character, not only the matched one.

truncated.description: True when the cap was reached. There is deliberately no pagination.
